description: Establish and confirm the green baseline for the ad/ subproject and add the isolated vitest config so the test suite runs reliably. This unblocks every later feature's verification. All commands run from /projects/sandbox/Lumen-Labs/.worktrees/cinematic-film/ad using the full node/npm path (npm is NOT on PATH).
steps: Set NPM="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/lib/node_modules/npm/bin/npm-cli.js". Confirm `node --version` is v22.x and `node "$NPM" --version` works from the ad/ dir.

Confirm baseline is already installed: node_modules exists and public/fonts/ already has the three vendored WOFF2 files (npm install + `npm run fonts` were done at baseline). If node_modules is missing, run `node "$NPM" install` then `node "$NPM" run fonts`.
Run `node "$NPM" run typecheck` and confirm it passes with zero errors (baseline green).

Add a new file ad/vitest.config.ts containing a minimal neutral config `export default {}` (as a proper TS default export, e.g. `import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config'; export default defineConfig({})` is fine too, but a bare `export default {}` is sufficient and matches baseline.md's neutral-config workaround). This stops vitest from walking up and auto-discovering the OUTER website's vite.config.ts. This is the ONE acceptable isolated config addition in the ad/ subproject.

Verify the existing test suite now runs via `node "$NPM" run test` (which runs `vitest run`) AND via the explicit neutral config `node "$NPM" exec -- vitest run --config /tmp/empty-vitest.config.ts` (create /tmp/empty-vitest.config.ts with `printf 'export default {}\n' > /tmp/empty-vitest.config.ts`). Both must show the existing 5 files / 16 tests passing (copy 2, timeline 3, assets 2, layout 4, interpolate 5).

Verify the bundled ffprobe is runnable: `node_modules/@remotion/compositor-linux-x64-gnu/ffprobe -version` prints a version. Verify edge-tts: `/root/.local/bin/edge-tts --list-voices | grep en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural` returns a line. Do NOT depend on bare `edge-tts` or bare `npm` being on PATH.

Commit on branch feat/cinematic-brand-film with a clear message (e.g. 'chore(ad): add isolated vitest config for cinematic film suite'). Stage only ad/vitest.config.ts (and package-lock.json only if it legitimately changed). Do NOT push.
acceptance_criteria: `node "$NPM" run typecheck` exits 0 with zero errors.
ad/vitest.config.ts exists and `node "$NPM" run test` starts vitest without the 'Cannot find package vite' error and passes all existing tests (5 files, 16 tests).
The neutral-config invocation `node "$NPM" exec -- vitest run --config /tmp/empty-vitest.config.ts` also passes all existing tests.
The bundled ffprobe prints a version and edge-tts lists the Andrew voice.
Only ad/vitest.config.ts (and optionally package-lock.json) is added; no existing source file is modified; a commit exists on feat/cinematic-brand-film.
findings: Baseline confirmed green and isolated vitest config added.
